priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore message-listener cleanup
findings.body: The function returned by attach previously removed the registered message handler. It now does nothing, so callers cannot detach; while the socket remains alive, handlers persist and repeated attach/cleanup cycles accumulate listeners, causing duplicate processing and memory retention.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts registers handler with socket.on("message", handler) at line 2 but the returned cleanup at changed line 3 is still an empty function. The full diff confirms this PR removed the prior socket.off("message", handler) call, so cleanup cannot detach the listener.
